grammar.title: In fact with 事实上
grammar.explanation: 事实上 (shìshí shang) means "in fact, actually" — it introduces the real situation, often correcting a wrong impression given earlier. It typically starts the sentence.

sentences.zh: 事实上，他没有去过北京。
sentences.pinyin: Shìshí shang, tā méiyǒu qùguo Běijīng.
sentences.en: In fact, he has never been to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 事实上，这个问题很简单。
sentences.pinyin: Shìshí shang, zhège wèntí hěn jiǎndān.
sentences.en: In fact, this problem is very simple.

sentences.pinyin: Shìshí shang, tā yīzhí hěn nǔlì.
sentences.en: In fact, he has always worked hard.
